would crash (LuxReplayChara_Tick dereferences +0x3A8 for memcpy).
The game does NOT crash, so this function is operating on a different
object whose +0x3A8 is benign.

  3. Calls FUN_1404879E0(this, DAT_143E8A05C) — large 3KB+ helper.
  4. Writes `*(byte*)(this+0x3A8) = 0` — zeroes a flag byte.

this vtable hasn't been identified. Could be any of the auxiliary
actors (StageInfinityManager, BattleAnnounce, CameraActor, etc.).

hardware breakpoint or runtime logging) that this function actually
mutates replay-relevant state during a HorseMod freeze. The previous
